Welcome to [Project Havoc] — a Fortnite project currently in early development!

🚧 Current State (Pre-Alpha):
Right now, it's just a baseplate and one working gun for testing mechanics. Full map, building, and more weapons are on the way!

🖥️ Device Compatibility:

PC: Supported (Keyboard & Mouse)

Controller: Coming Soon 🎮

Mobile: Not Supported 🚫


Step into the early testing grounds of [Project Havoc]! Test out the core shooting mechanics on the baseplate while the full Battle Royale experience is being built.

🛠️ Version 0.1 Features:

More guns, building, and full map coming soon!

💻 Platforms: PC | 🎮 Controller in!!! | 📱Mobile support 

👍 Leave a LIKE to support development!
